metadata.name: entry
metadata.description: launch entry: open the identity-wallet profile window. origin.launch hydrates this segment (+ the profile/keystore/window libs) then runs the entry.

manifests.name: profileapp
manifests.description: the identity wallet — create/unlock your keypair, reshuffle, change passcode, export/import keystore file, recovery phrase — as an installable origin-application. The profile/keystore/window libs are boot-loaded origin deps (like file-explorer for filesapp).
